newsitem.title: CANADA: Livent to open second "Ragtime" show.
newsitem.headline: Livent to open second "Ragtime" show.

text.p: Livent Inc said on Thursday it will form a second company for its US$8 million dollar musical stage production of E.L. Doctorow's early 20th century novel, "Ragtime" less than a week after the show's world premiere.
The theater owner and entertainment company said the second company will be formed for the musical's U.S. premiere engagement at the 2,100-seat Shubert theater in Century City, Los Angeles.
It said rehearsals for the Los Angeles company will begin in April 1997, with an opening show anticipated to be in June.

Livent also said that due to unprecedented demand, ticket sales for its world premiere engagement of "Ragtime" in Toronto have been extended until April 27, 1997, when the production will move to New York to prepare for its Broadway run beginning in December 1997.
